assets.name: Smoke measurement
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [direct] to "Fire not detected" (fatality)

properties.description: Current smoke density from the optical chamber — direct input of the alarm decision.

securityGoals.rationale: A smoke density value is not secret.

securityGoals.formalDescription: The smoke measurement shall be protected against manipulation between optical chamber and alarm decision.
The smoke measurement shall reach the alarm decision continuously; loss shall be detected and reported as a fault.
securityGoals.rationale: The alarm decision needs a continuous measurement; a lost stream must become a fault.
Single measurement values are not evidence; alarms are recorded in the audit log (DA-010).

securityGoals.rationale: Coefficients are product know-how, not a security secret.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Calibration parameters shall only be changed by an authorised calibration procedure and shall be integrity-protected at rest.
Calibration parameters shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.
securityGoals.rationale: Loaded at start-up; a missing calibration leads to a fault state, not to a silent failure.
